title: U.S. House · Ohio's 6th District
area: Eastern Ohio, including the Mahoning Valley and Ohio River counties

context.text: The Cook Political Report rates the 6th District R+17, a safely Republican-leaning seat.

candidates.name: Michael Rulli
candidates.ballotNote: Incumbent; defeated Jullie Kelley in the May 5, 2026 Republican primary

summary.text: Rulli is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Ohio's 6th District, elected in a 2024 special election. He previously served in the Ohio State Senate and as a Leetonia, Ohio school board member.

background.text: Born in Mahoning County, Ohio; graduated from Poland Seminary High School and earned a degree from Emerson College.
Worked as director of operations with Rulli Bros. Markets; served as a Leetonia, Ohio school board member and in the Ohio State Senate before being elected to Congress.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce (Health; Oversight and Investigations; Energy subcommittees) in the 119th Congress (2025-2026).

candidates.name: Elizabeth Kirtley
candidates.ballotNote: Won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary in a six-candidate field

summary.text: Kirtley is the Democratic nominee, running on a platform centered on due process, abolishing ICE, codifying Roe v. Wade, and protecting constitutional rights.

priorities.text: Campaign website calls to 'Abolish ICE,' saying due process 'is a right, not a privilege' and that constitutional freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion should not be prohibited.
priorities.quote: Abolish Ice. Due Process is a right; not a privilege.

priorities.text: Campaign website calls for codifying Roe v. Wade, saying abortion access is a matter between a woman, her doctor, and her faith.
priorities.quote: Codify Roe. Life, Liberty, and the Pursuit of Happiness includes a Woman's Right to Choose.

priorities.text: Campaign website calls for 'fair and safe voting' in which every American has one equal vote, and for accountability from national news organizations.

positions.summary: Campaign website calls for codifying Roe v. Wade to protect abortion access.
positions.quote: Life, Liberty, and the Pursuit of Happiness includes a Woman's Right to Choose.

positions.summary: Campaign website calls to abolish ICE and emphasizes due-process rights.
positions.quote: Abolish Ice. Due Process is a right; not a privilege.
